name: CLIMATIK Climate Transition Platform
hero_sub_en: CT-XS-004 · Climate Risk & Disclosure · CT-XS-003 · Green Finance
hero_sub_es: CT-XS-004 · Riesgo climático y divulgación · CT-XS-003 · Finanzas verdes
pitch_en: We connect climate language with financial language to accelerate transition — climate-intelligence SaaS for manufacturers without changing ERP.
pitch_es: Conectamos el lenguaje climático con el financiero para acelerar la transición — SaaS de inteligencia climática para manufactureras sin cambiar ERP.
cta_pitch_en: Private capital will not move without reliable climate information.
cta_pitch_es: El capital privado no se moverá sin información climática fiable.

sections.head_en: Climate KPIs and decisions based on existing operational data
sections.head_es: KPIs climáticos y decisiones basadas en datos operacionales existentes
sections.body_en: Annual SaaS subscription (~$13,286 USD/year weighted average in deck). Connects climate and financial language for manufacturers.
sections.body_es: Suscripción SaaS anual (~$13.286 USD/año promedio ponderado en deck). Conecta lenguaje climático y financiero para manufactureras.

steps.text_en: Native SAP B1 / Dynamics 365 integration — no ERP change.
steps.text_es: Integración nativa SAP B1 / Dynamics 365 — sin cambiar ERP.

steps.text_en: GHG Protocol scope 1–2, PCAF, local emission factors.
steps.text_es: GHG Protocol alcance 1–2, PCAF, factores locales.

steps.text_en: ESG confidence for banks and investors.
steps.text_es: Confianza ESG para bancos e inversionistas.

steps.text_en: Lower cost and operational risk vs consultants.
steps.text_es: Menor costo y riesgo operativo vs consultores.

sections.note_en: Deck: weighted average subscription; auditable local emission data.
sections.note_es: Deck: suscripción promedio ponderada; datos de emisión locales auditables.

cards.text_en: Climate intelligence outputs tied to operational quality & energy indicators.
cards.text_es: Salidas de inteligencia climática ligadas a indicadores de calidad y energía.
